title: sar-cose: minimal reference implementation of the Sovereign Acceptance Runtime (SAR)
description:
Reference implementation of the authorization path of the Sovereign Acceptance Runtime (SAR) described in the working paper Sovereign Acceptance Runtime: Verifiable Human Ratification and Evidentiary Audit Trails for Autonomous AI Agents under the EU AI Act (v1.1, October 2026).

Proposal and Ratification Statements are COSE_Sign1 objects (RFC 9052) over deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 section 4.2.1), signed with Ed25519 (algorithm -19, RFC 9864). A fail-closed Execution Gate evaluates the Registration Policy, verifies signed human ratifications, compares the runtime payload digest with the ratified one, and consumes authorizations atomically in a hash-chained SQLite store. Includes a 55-test conformance suite (original harness, gap tests, COSE/CBOR tests, differential, property-based and concurrency tests) and mutation analysis (19/19 mutants killed).

Research prototype; not production software. Transparency Service integration (SCITT Receipts) is not implemented.
